title: Chris Lattner: The Future of Computing and Programming Languages | Lex Fridman Podcast #131
summary: Lex Fridman's long interview with Chris Lattner, creator of LLVM and Swift, covering the future of computing and programming languages. It touches on compilers, hardware, and his work at Apple, Tesla, Google and SiFive.
why: Mentioned as an interesting Lattner conversation whenever Swift, LLVM or language design come up.

quote.text: I watched a couple of Lex Fridman podcasts this week with Chris Lattner (creator of Swift) that I thought were interesting
